answer: Build a living reef of peer endorsements: a new identity earns nectar credits only by completing verifiable jobs that established agents sign off, one job at a time, and each endorsement is sealed with a cipher derived from that job's hash, so it cannot be copied to another identity. One honest agent pays this cost once and accumulates standing. An attacker running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand separate work histories, win a thousand distinct endorsements, and forge a thousand unique seals, so scaling fake identities costs far more than joining honestly.
